limitations: Not the complete overlook-to-boardwalk route or all park routes.
Ideal centerline steering; no manual-controller or visual-quality certification.
Independent cases have an initial placement and settling period; positions are never corrected within a walk.
Water/swimming, vehicles, side-of-deck railing impacts, arbitrary off-trail traversal, and hardware performance are outside this test.
scope: Focused native-collision walks: two bridges in both directions, upper overlook approach, one boardwalk junction.
historical_record: Initial moving-body check before Midway bridge profile/rail and overlook-entry repairs; retained for diagnosis, superseded by walking_validation.json after repairs.
